InfoPage.title: What are you interested in?

parkingList.item1: Parking on Velké náměstí and Kostelním náměstí is allowed exclusively for vehicles with confirmed registration.
parkingList.item2: Vehicles without valid registration will not be allowed to enter or park in these locations.
parkingList.item3: Given that the event takes place in the historical city center, we recommend local visitors to arrive on foot.
parkingList.item4: For visitors who need to arrive by car, we recommend using adjacent parking areas outside the city center.
parkingList.item5: Exhibitors bringing their vehicles on a trailer can use the <mapLink>Menšíkova</mapLink> parking lot for trailer parking.
parkingList.item6: We ask all event participants to follow these rules, which are necessary to ensure safety, smooth traffic, and the smooth running of the event.

rulesList.item1: Please do not touch the vehicles without the permission of the owner or authorized person. In case of damage (including by your child), you take full responsibility and the vehicle owner may claim damages. Such behavior may lead to expulsion from the event area.
rulesList.item2: Avoid any behavior that could endanger health or property.
rulesList.item3: You give consent to a security check upon entry and potential storage of prohibited items.
rulesList.item4: You agree to the taking of photos and videos from the event and acknowledge that you may appear in published materials.
rulesList.item5: Do not enter under the influence of alcohol or drugs, and do not consume them in the event area.
rulesList.item6: If you see anyone damaging property, report it immediately to the organizing team.
rulesList.item7: All movement in the event area is at your own risk.
rulesList.item8: The organizers reserve the right to change the program, participants, or partners.

conditions.title: Registration & Conditions
conditions.p1: There is one exhibition area – Velké náměstí, Prachatice with a capacity of up to 100 vehicles.
conditions.p1_selection: Selection of vehicles for approval will take place.
conditions.warning: Strict ban on burnouts and pops & bangs in the entire exhibition area.
conditions.p2: All registrations are responded to by email. Once your registration for Salty Road Meet is approved, you will receive a confirmation email with instructions for paying the registration fee.
conditions.feeList2: Gift package from Salty Road and our partners
conditions.p3: After payment is received, we will send you your registration confirmation with a registration number (needed for accreditation) and complete exhibitor instructions.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This policy describes what personal data we process in connection with the Salty Road Meet event, why, and what rights you have. Processing is carried out in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Czech Act No. 110/2019 Coll., on personal data processing.
PrivacyPage.controllerText: The data controller is Zephyron Tech s.r.o., Company ID (IČO) 23793538, Čermákova 2587/60, Jižní Předměstí, 301 00 Plzeň, Czech Republic. You can contact us regarding data protection at info@saltyroad.cz.

dataList.item1: Registration form: first name, last name, email, Instagram (optional), vehicle brand, model and year, vehicle description, vehicle photos.
dataList.item2: Registration and payment status: internal approval status, registration fee payment status, event arrival confirmation.
dataList.item3: Technical data: when visiting the site we process anonymized, aggregated traffic data (Vercel Web Analytics) — this service does not use cookies or store data that could identify an individual.

PrivacyPage.purposeTitle: 3. Purpose and legal basis of processing

purposeList.item1: Organizing your vehicle's registration for the event and communicating about its status — performance of a contract / pre-contractual steps (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
purposeList.item2: Publishing approved vehicles on the website (name, photo, description) — performance of a contract based on the consent given at registration.
purposeList.item3: Website operation and security, registration administration and event entry management — legitimate interest of the controller (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
purposeList.item4: Aggregated website traffic (Vercel Analytics) — legitimate interest of the controller, without processing personal identifiers.

PrivacyPage.cookiesText: The website only uses technical cookies necessary for the admin and crew (organizing team) login to the non-public part of the site (PIN entry). These cookies do not track visitors and do not require consent under Czech Electronic Communications Act § 89. Website analytics (Vercel Web Analytics) does not use cookies.

recipientsList.item1: Vercel Inc. — website hosting, photo storage and analytics (processor).
recipientsList.item4: We do not share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.

PrivacyPage.retentionText: We retain registration data for the duration of the event preparation and the event itself, and for a reasonable period afterwards (in particular for handling complaints and accounting obligations), but no longer than 12 months after the event, unless required otherwise by law.

rightsList.item1: Right to access your personal data and receive a copy.
rightsList.item2: Right to rectification of inaccurate data.
rightsList.item3: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten").
rightsList.item4: Right to restrict processing and right to object.
rightsList.item6: Right to lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (uoou.cz).

PrivacyPage.contactText: You can exercise your rights by emailing info@saltyroad.cz.
